notes: Fiscal year mapping: the audited historical figures are labeled by BD as the years ended September 30 (FY2023–FY2025). ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000010795-25-000099/bdx-20250930.htm))

EBIT is proxied by reported Operating Income from the consolidated statement of income. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000010795-25-000099/bdx-20250930.htm))

D&A and capex are taken from the segment totals tables in the FY2025 10-K (converted to full units). ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000010795-25-000099/bdx-20250930.htm))

NWC definition (simplified, consistent for all years): NWC = (Total current assets − cash and equivalents − restricted cash − short-term investments) − (Total current liabilities − current debt obligations). This excludes cash from working capital and treats current debt obligations as financing, not operating NWC. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000010795-25-000099/bdx-20250930.htm))
WACC is not disclosed in the retrieved filings; set as an assumption (0.085 base).
NOL balance was not extracted into an explicit NOL-dollar line item during this run; nol_balance set to null and nol_utilization_pct set to 0.80 as a modeling placeholder.
Comps: forward (NTM) EV/Revenue and EV/EBITDA were not reliably available from accessible free sources in this run, so those fields are null by design.

Mismatch caution: FY2026 guidance in the press release is presented for 'New BD' post separation mechanics, while historical financials here are from BD’s FY2025 consolidated reporting; this may require pro-forma adjustments for strict LTM comparability. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/936/bd-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2026-financial-results))

catalysts: Ongoing execution on BD’s FY2026 New BD outlook following the separation/combination with Waters expected to close on Feb 9, 2026. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/936/bd-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2026-financial-results))

Sustained organic demand and pricing discipline that keeps revenue growth in the low single-digit-plus range and supports gradual margin improvement. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/936/bd-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2026-financial-results))
company_overview: BD is a global medical technology company with operations organized around medical and life-science/interventional offerings (historically reported as Medical, Life Sciences, and Interventional). ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000010795-25-000099/bdx-20250930.htm))

In its fiscal 2026 first-quarter reporting, BD re-organized into five separately managed segments: Medical Essentials, Connected Care, BioPharma Systems, BD Interventional, and BD Life Sciences. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/936/bd-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2026-financial-results))
current_context: Fiscal Q1 2026 (ended Dec 31, 2025): revenues were $5.252B (+1.6% reported; +0.4% FX-neutral). ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/936/bd-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2026-financial-results))

FY2026 New BD guidance (as of Feb 9, 2026): GAAP revenue growth expected to be low single-digit plus (FXN) and adjusted diluted EPS expected at $12.35 to $12.65. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/936/bd-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2026-financial-results))
investment_highlights: Base-case assumes a low-to-mid single digit revenue growth profile consistent with BD’s FY2026 low single-digit plus guidance framing. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/936/bd-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2026-financial-results))

EBIT margin model assumes modest expansion from FY2025 operating profitability toward ~12.2% by FY2030, consistent with recent levels of operating income relative to revenues. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000010795-25-000099/bdx-20250930.htm))

Capital intensity is modeled as moderating from the FY2023 spike toward a sustained mid- to high-3% of sales capex rate. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000010795-25-000099/bdx-20250930.htm))

Net working capital is modeled as stable as a percent of sales (roughly mid-7% range) based on the last three fiscal-year balance sheet snapshots and a simplified NWC definition. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000010795-25-000099/bdx-20250930.htm))
key_risks: Regulatory, litigation, and product liability exposures typical for medical technology companies, which can affect reported earnings and cash flows. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000010795-25-000099/bdx-20250930.htm))

Execution/integration risk and business-mix shifts related to the New BD separation mechanics could make year-to-year comparability less direct. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/936/bd-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2026-financial-results))

presentation.subtitle: BDX DCF Inputs (Fiscal 2025 base; FY2026-FY2030 drivers)
valuation_summary: The DCF base case is built from audited FY2023–FY2025 income statement and cash flow items (revenue, operating income as EBIT, D&A, and capex), then extended using conservative growth and modest margin drift. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000010795-25-000099/bdx-20250930.htm))

Terminal value uses a Gordon growth approach with a 2.0% terminal growth assumption and a cash/debt plug based on FY2025 year-end balances. ([investors.bd.com](https://investors.bd.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000010795-25-000099/bdx-20250930.htm))
Peer comps are included as a framework, but forward (NTM) EV/Revenue and EV/EBITDA were not reliably available from accessible free sources during this run (left as nulls).
